“I can appreciate how you FEEL about trusting an RV Outfitter because many Customers have FELT the same way, including me, but what I FOUND…
With a genuine smile: “Hey, eventually you are going to have to trust some poor RV Outfitter, so give me a chance?”
“Wait right here, I have a great idea.”

children.text: Customer is resistant. This happens. Don't take personally. The manual has your back — try the disarm, or turn.
Waiting for a manager to approve the turn
“I’m sorry, have I done something to offend you?”
“I can appreciate how you FEEL about trusting an RV Outfitter because many Customers have FELT the same way, including me, but what I FOUND…
With a genuine smile: “Hey, eventually you are going to have to trust some poor RV Outfitter, so give me a chance?”
“Wait right here, I have a great idea.”
This technique will freeze the Customer for at least 10–45 minutes. Then go do a manager check and/or turn the Customer to an RV Outfitter t

“I’m sorry, have I done something to offend you?”
“I can appreciate how you FEEL about trusting an RV Outfitter because many Customers have FELT the same way, including me, but what I FOUND…
With a genuine smile: “Hey, eventually you are going to have to trust some poor RV Outfitter, so give me a chance?”
“Wait right here, I have a great idea.”

Chris is on deck · half a deal > no deal
Needs a manager turn or intervention
“I’m sorry, have I done something to offend you?”
“I can appreciate how you FEEL about trusting an RV Outfitter because many Customers have FELT the same way, including me, but what I FOUND…
With a genuine smile: “Hey, eventually you are going to have to trust some poor RV Outfitter, so give me a chance?”
“Wait right here, I have a great idea.”

“I can appreciate how you FEEL about trusting an RV Outfitter because many Customers have FELT the same way, including me, but what I FOUND…
With a genuine smile: “Hey, eventually you are going to have to trust some poor RV Outfitter, so give me a chance?”
“Wait right here, I have a great idea.”

“I can appreciate how you FEEL about trusting an RV Outfitter because many Customers have FELT the same way, including me, but what I FOUND…
With a genuine smile: “Hey, eventually you are going to have to trust some poor RV Outfitter, so give me a chance?”
